title.en: Install from Google Play, or move from the old app
title.hi: Google Play se install, ya purane app se shift
title.mr: Google Play madhun install, kinva junya app varun shift

description.en: Install Sales X-Ray from Google Play. Had the old download-link app? Wait for All changes saved, uninstall it, then install from Play. Your leads and calls stay safe.
description.hi: Google Play se Sales X-Ray install kijiye. Purana download-link wala app tha? All changes saved ka wait kijiye, use uninstall kijiye, phir Play se install. Aapke leads aur calls safe rehte hain.
description.mr: Google Play madhun Sales X-Ray install kara. Juna download-link wala app hota? All changes saved chi vaat bagha, to uninstall kara, mag Play madhun install. Tumche leads aani calls safe rahtat.

title.hi: App ke andar sign in kijiye

say.en: Installing Sales X-Ray from Google Play, or moving over from the old download-link app, safely.
say.hi: Google Play से Sales X-Ray install करना, या पुराने download-link वाले app से safely shift करना.
say.mr: Google Play मधून Sales X-Ray install करणं, किंवा जुन्या download-link वाल्या app वरून safely shift होणं.

latn.hi: Google Play se Sales X-Ray install karna, ya purane download-link wale app se safely shift karna.
latn.mr: Google Play madhun Sales X-Ray install karna, kinva junya download-link valya app varun safely shift hona.

say.en: Next: signing in inside the app.
say.hi: अगले video में: app के अंदर sign in कैसे करें.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: app मध्येच sign in कसं करायचं.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: app ke andar sign in kaise karein.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: app madhyech sign in kasa karaycha.

text.en: Old app? Move to Play safely
text.hi: Purana app? Play pe safe shift
text.mr: Juna app? Play var safe shift

say.en: Moving from the old app to Google Play? Do it in this order.
say.hi: पुराने app से Google Play पे जा रहे हैं? इसी order में कीजिए.
say.mr: जुन्या app वरून Google Play वर जाताय? याच order मध्ये करा.

latn.hi: Purane app se Google Play pe ja rahe hain? Isi order mein kijiye.
latn.mr: Junya app varun Google Play var jaatay? Yach order madhye kara.

say.en: New to Sales X-Ray? Just open Google Play and tap Install. Updates then come through Play, like any other app.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray नया है? बस Google Play खोलिए और Install दबाइए. फिर updates Play से ही आएँगे, बाकी apps की तरह.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray नवीन आहे? फक्त Google Play उघडा आणि Install दाबा. मग updates Play मधूनच येतील, बाकीच्या apps सारखे.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray naya hai? Bas Google Play kholiye aur Install dabaiye. Phir updates Play se hi aayenge, baaki apps ki tarah.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray navin aahe? Fakta Google Play ughda aani Install daba. Mag updates Play madhunach yetil, baakichya apps sarkhe.

say.en: When there's an update, Sales X-Ray's page on Google Play shows Update. Tap it.
say.hi: Update आया हो, तो Google Play पे Sales X-Ray के page पे Update दिखेगा. उसे दबाइए.
say.mr: Update आला असेल, तर Google Play वर Sales X-Ray च्या page वर Update दिसेल. ते दाबा.

latn.hi: Update aaya ho, toh Google Play pe Sales X-Ray ke page pe Update dikhega. Use dabaiye.
latn.mr: Update aala asel, tar Google Play var Sales X-Ray chya page var Update disel. Te daba.

say.en: Play downloads and installs it in a few seconds.
say.hi: Play कुछ ही seconds में download और install कर देता है.
say.mr: Play काही seconds मध्ये download आणि install करतो.

latn.hi: Play kuch hi seconds mein download aur install kar deta hai.
latn.mr: Play kahi seconds madhye download aani install karto.

say.en: Then tap Open. Your leads and calls are all still there.
say.hi: फिर Open दबाइए. आपके leads और calls सब वहीं हैं.
say.mr: मग Open दाबा. तुमचे leads आणि calls सगळे तिथेच आहेत.

latn.hi: Phir Open dabaiye. Aapke leads aur calls sab wahin hain.
latn.mr: Mag Open daba. Tumche leads aani calls sagle tithech aahet.

say.en: Had the older app from a download link? It's signed differently from the Play app, so Android can't update one into the other. You switch just once.
say.hi: पहले download link वाला पुराना app था? उसका signature Play वाले app से अलग है, इसलिए Android उसे update नहीं कर सकता. बस एक बार switch करना है.
say.mr: आधी download link वाला जुना app होता? त्याची signature Play च्या app पेक्षा वेगळी आहे, म्हणून Android तो update करू शकत नाही. फक्त एकदा switch करायचं.

latn.hi: Pehle download link wala purana app tha? Uska signature Play wale app se alag hai, isliye Android use update nahi kar sakta. Bas ek baar switch karna hai.
latn.mr: Aadhi download link wala juna app hota? Tyachi signature Play chya app peksha vegli aahe, mhanun Android to update karu shakat nahi. Fakta ekda switch karaycha.

say.en: First, open the old app, and wait until it says All changes saved. That means everything you did has reached us.
say.hi: पहले पुराना app खोलिए, और All changes saved आने तक रुकिए. मतलब आपका सारा काम हम तक पहुँच गया.
say.mr: आधी जुना app उघडा, आणि All changes saved येईपर्यंत थांबा. म्हणजे तुमचं सगळं काम आमच्यापर्यंत पोहोचलं.

latn.hi: Pehle purana app kholiye, aur All changes saved aane tak rukiye. Matlab aapka saara kaam hum tak pahunch gaya.
latn.mr: Aadhi juna app ughda, aani All changes saved yeiparyant thamba. Mhanje tumcha sagla kaam aamchyaparyant pohochla.

say.en: Then long-press the Sales X-Ray icon, tap App info, and Uninstall.
say.hi: फिर Sales X-Ray के icon को दबाकर रखिए, App info खोलिए, और Uninstall कीजिए.
say.mr: मग Sales X-Ray च्या icon वर दाबून ठेवा, App info उघडा, आणि Uninstall करा.

latn.hi: Phir Sales X-Ray ke icon ko dabakar rakhiye, App info kholiye, aur Uninstall kijiye.
latn.mr: Mag Sales X-Ray chya icon var dabun theva, App info ughda, aani Uninstall kara.

say.en: Now install Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach from Google Play, and sign in. Your leads and calls are all still there.
say.hi: अब Google Play से Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install कीजिए, और sign in कीजिए. आपके leads और calls सब वहीं हैं.
say.mr: आता Google Play मधून Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install करा, आणि sign in करा. तुमचे leads आणि calls सगळे तिथेच आहेत.

latn.hi: Ab Google Play se Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install kijiye, aur sign in kijiye. Aapke leads aur calls sab wahin hain.
latn.mr: Aata Google Play madhun Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install kara, aani sign in kara. Tumche leads aani calls sagle tithech aahet.

target.name: No Play invite? Download the app

say.en: Both links live in Settings, under Phone and alerts. No Play invite yet? The download link works until it arrives.
say.hi: दोनों links Settings में, Phone and alerts के अंदर हैं. Play invite अभी नहीं आया? तब तक download link चलेगा.
say.mr: दोन्ही links Settings मध्ये, Phone and alerts मध्ये आहेत. Play invite अजून आलं नाही? तोपर्यंत download link चालेल.

latn.hi: Dono links Settings mein, Phone and alerts ke andar hain. Play invite abhi nahi aaya? Tab tak download link chalega.
latn.mr: Donhi links Settings madhye, Phone and alerts madhye aahet. Play invite ajun aala nahi? Toparyant download link chalel.
